title: Museum Studies and Art Gallery
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Museum Studies and Art Gallery (Certificate N0988)
outcomes: Identify various roles in the museum and gallery systems.
Apply and analyze historic and contemporary art theory within museum and gallery systems.
Apply design concepts, installation and lighting techniques, and fabrication skills towards a cohesive exhibition design.
Operate equipment and tools, common to the field, safely toward fabrication related to exhibition installation, packing, and presentation.
Communicate effectively and timely within the network of museum and gallery systems to publicize artists, exhibitions, and programs.
Analyze, critique, and evaluate exhibition design, concepts, planning and installation, and execution of contemporary exhibitions.
Analyze artwork, design, installation, fabrication, and concept, within the context of historic and contemporary theory.
Apply design concepts, installation techniques, fabrication skills, and exhibition concept toward the production of a purposeful exhibition.
Demonstrate networking and communication knowledge related to approaching and interacting with museum and art gallery professionals in relation to contemporary practice.

notes: The catalog prints the art history electives under the ARTH subject while the closed list stores AHIS codes with identical titles; ARTH codes were recorded as catalog additions. A reviewer should confirm the AHIS-to-ARTH subject change.
ARTH 6H, ARTH 11H and ARTH C1200H matched the closed-list entries ARTH6H, ARTH11H and ARTHC1200H (spacing differences only).
Elective courses have no units printed beside them; units left null. The block 'Required Electives' prints 6 units.
ARTG 22A is a variable-unit course; the catalog says 'A minimum of two units required' and prints 2-3.

The page prints two outcome lists: six outcomes in the overview ('Students who successfully complete the program will be able to:') and three Program Learning Outcomes on the outcomes tab; both recorded in program.outcomes.
The program description also mentions 'entry-level occupations related to museum studies and art gallery'; only the specific job titles listed were recorded as careers.
